Getting Started with Plotly

getting-started.Rmd

Getting Started with Plotly for R

plotly.core is an R package for creating interactive web-based graphs via the open source JavaScript graphing library plotly.js. Figures are built from typed graph objects (go_figure(), add_scatter(), go_scatter_marker(), …) that validate every property against the plotly.js schema.

Graphs created with plotly.core are rendered locally through the htmlwidgets framework.

Installation

Download from GitHub

plotly.core has not been submitted to CRAN yet. Install the development version from GitHub via the remotes R package:

remotes::install_github("msummersgill/plotly.R.core")

Note For RStudio Users

RStudio users should ensure that they are using the latest RStudio release in order to ensure compatibility with the htmlwidgets R package.

Rendering Charts

By default, figures created with plotly.core render locally in your web browser or in the RStudio viewer.

library(plotly.core)

midwest <- ggplot2::midwest

midwest |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_box(x = ~percollege, marker = go_box_marker(color = ~state))

Simply printing the figure object will render the chart locally in your web browser or in the RStudio viewer.

Graphs created with plotly.core are interactive!

Click on legend entries to hide/show traces, click-and-drag on the chart to zoom, double-click to autoscale, shift-and-drag to pan.

Next Steps

Once you have installed plotly.core, learn more about the structure of a figure and start making basic charts.
